unsupported_by_default.tensorrt_full_libs: Compatible wheels exist, but full TensorRT libraries are multi-GB per CUDA lane. Install only in an explicit TensorRT image/profile or GPU-worker build, not the default wheel-only ML lanes.
unsupported_by_default.flash_attn: Requires GPU-worker/toolchain validation. Do not build from source inside wheel-only CPU image refresh.
unsupported_by_default.pyannote.audio_latest: Latest releases may pull Torch/Numpy versions outside the pinned CUDA lane contract. Use speechbrain/silero-vad by default or validate pyannote on a GPU worker.
